Department of Commerce announces transition of Baldrige Performance Excellence Program

status_summary: NIST released a statement dated 2025-12-11 (updated 2026-01-16) saying the Department of Commerce had finalized agreements to transfer management and operations of the Baldrige Award process, the Quest for Excellence conference, framework revisions and the Executive Fellows Program to the Alliance for Performance Excellence and the Baldrige Foundation, starting with the 2026 award cycle. NIST and Commerce keep ultimate responsibility for the Excellence Framework, the award process and other requirements under 15 U.S.C. 3711a, so the handover is to two partners and is not complete.

timeline.event: NIST announced finalized agreements transferring management and operations of the award process, the Quest for Excellence conference, framework revisions and the Executive Fellows Program to two private-sector partners, beginning with the 2026 award cycle; NIST retains ultimate responsibility for the framework and award process.

title: Hand the Baldrige Performance Excellence Program to the Baldrige Foundation
uncertainties: The NIST page states its release date and an update date in the page text; the news article is dated 2025-12-16. Neither source says which partner takes which function. Whether the 2026 cycle is in fact being run by the partners, and whether federal funding and fee arrangements changed, were not checked; the stage relies on the finalized agreements and their stated start.
